label: Mileage Webhook Demo
info:
Demo/test flow for the Mileage Logger app's Node-RED sync feature.

The app POSTs here with Content-Type: text/plain (deliberately — see the app's README for why: it dodges CORS preflight, which Node-RED's core http-in node can't handle anyway since it has no OPTIONS method). The body is still a JSON string, so this flow parses it manually with JSON.parse.

After deploying: in the app's Settings tab, set the webhook URL to https://<your-address>:1881/api/timesheet/submit and hit "Send test ping". Watch the debug sidebar (the bug icon, top right) for the incoming payload.
